conclusions: Changing only the recorded sub-roundoff-scale initial rotation component on the same PC is sufficient to produce metre-scale DR differences over this prefix.
This establishes numerical sensitivity in the controlled frozen DR chain, not a unique failing operation, physical sensor cause, or validated remedy.
The counterfactual does not reproduce the actual returned ARM DR trajectory; ARM numerical-library and full execution-path differences remain unresolved.
No formal full-route acceptance decision, navigation change, threshold relaxation or new Jetson workload is implied.
procedure_note: One preliminary compare was mistakenly started while the diagnostic gzip writer was active and raised EOFError. It created no report and was discarded. The 33334-sample comparison was then run after the completed summary existed, without restarting either replay or the formal simulation.
limitations: Only the first 6666.6 seconds (approximately 10 km) and the independent DR channel were controlled.
This is a PC counterfactual, not an ARM DR-only execution; no standalone ARM control has run.
The ARM comparison uses network returns; the full-route actual-board-artifact equality audit is still pending.
Initial rotations are post-initialization matrices, not changed physical initial truth.
CPU quotas were requests only: cpu.max is absent. Actual memory.max=1 GiB, Nice=19 and NLWP=1 were observed.
Host diagnostics overlapped with the live HIL run; performance is not a clean-room exclusive benchmark.
Diagnostic results and all prior high-error samples are retained, not substituted into production output.
